name: typeform
label: Typeform
description: Create beautiful online forms and surveys

oauth2.scope: webhooks:write forms:read forms:write accounts:read responses:read responses:write workspaces:read workspaces:write themes:read themes:write images:read images:write offline

list_forms.label: List Forms
list_forms.description: Lists forms in the Typeform account.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only forms whose title contains this text.

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: How many items to return per page, from 1 to 200.

get_form.label: Get Form
get_form.description: Gets a form with its questions, logic and settings.

create_form.label: Create Form
create_form.description: Creates a new form, empty or with questions.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Leave empty for your default workspace.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Leave empty for Typeform's default theme.

fields.label: Questions
fields.description: A JSON array of Typeform question objects.

update_form.label: Update Form
update_form.description: Changes a form's title, public status, theme or workspace.

isPublic.label: Public
isPublic.description: Whether the form is open and accepts responses.

replace_form.label: Replace Form
replace_form.description: Replaces a form's whole definition, including its questions.

definition.label: Form Definition
definition.description: The full form JSON from Get Form, with your changes. Must include title.

allowFieldDeletion.label: Allow Field Deletion
allowFieldDeletion.description: Allow removing existing questions. Their responses are deleted too.

duplicate_form.label: Duplicate Form
duplicate_form.description: Creates a copy of an existing form.

title.label: Title
title.description: Leave empty for "Copy of" and the original title.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.description: Leave empty to keep the original form's workspace.

update_choice_options.label: Update Choice Options
update_choice_options.description: Replaces the options of a choice question in a form.

field.label: Question
field.description: Dropdown, multiple choice, ranking and picture choice questions.

choices.label: Options
choices.description: One label per option, in the order they should appear. A JSON array of labels.

delete_form.label: Delete Form
delete_form.description: Permanently deletes a form and all of its responses.

get_form_messages.label: Get Form Messages
get_form_messages.description: Gets the button labels, error messages and other texts of a form.

update_form_messages.label: Update Form Messages
update_form_messages.description: Changes button labels, error messages and other texts of a form.

messages.label: Messages
messages.description: JSON object of message keys and their new text.

update_form_messages.beforeRequest: const m=JSON.parse(inputs.messages);if(typeof m!=='object'||m===null||Array.isArray(m)||Object.keys(m).length===0)throw new Error('Messages must be a JSON object with at least one key.');return request;

list_responses.label: Find Responses
list_responses.description: Looks up responses to a form.

query.label: Search
query.description: Only responses containing this text in any answer or hidden field.

since.label: Submitted After
since.description: An ISO date and time, such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

until.label: Submitted Before
until.description: An ISO date and time, such as 2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z.

responseType.label: Response Type
responseType.description: Leave empty for completed responses only.

includedResponseIds.label: Response IDs
includedResponseIds.description: Only return the responses with these IDs. A JSON array of IDs.

before.label: Before Response
before.description: Response token. Returns responses submitted before it, for paging.

after.label: After Response
after.description: Response token. Returns responses submitted after it.

delete_responses.label: Delete Responses
delete_responses.description: Permanently deletes responses from a form.

responseIds.label: Response IDs
responseIds.description: A JSON array of response IDs.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only workspaces whose name contains this text.

accountId.label: Account ID
